 Rockets vs. Jazz Game Info
 Date: Friday, November 13, 2026
 Time: 8:30 p.m. ET
 Venue: Toyota Center -- Houston, Texas
 Coverage: KJZZ, Jazz+, SCHN, and SCHN+
 The Utah Jazz (1-11) visit the Houston Rockets (9-3) after losing five road games in a row. The Rockets are double-digit favorites by 15.5 points in the contest, which starts at 8:30 p.m. ET on Friday, November 13, 2026. The point total in the matchup is 220.5.
 Rockets vs. Jazz Odds & Spread
 All NBA betting lines, odds and prop bets are from FanDuel Sportsbook.
 Favorite Spread Total Favorite Moneyline Underdog Moneyline 
 Rockets -15.5 220.5 -1099 +700 
 Rockets vs. Jazz Prediction & Pick
 All NBA win probability predictions and picks are according to numberFire. 
 Prediction: Rockets win (84.7%)
 Rockets vs. Jazz Betting Trends
 The Rockets have covered the spread in a game nine times this season (9-3-0).
 The Jazz have covered the spread two times this year.
 Rockets games have gone over the total seven times this season.
 Jazz games this season have hit the over 25% of the time (three out of 12 games with a set point total).
 Houston sports a better record against the spread in home games (6-1-0) than it does in away games (3-2-0).
 The Rockets have gone over the over/under less consistently when playing at home, hitting the over in four of seven home matchups (57.1%). On the road, they have hit the over in three of five games (60%).
 In 2026-27 against the spread, Utah has a better winning percentage at home (.286, 2-5-0 record) than on the road (.000, 0-5-0).
 In terms of the over/under, Jazz games have gone over two of seven times at home (28.6%), and one of five away (20%).
 Rockets Leaders
 Alperen Sengun averages 21.1 points, 9.4 boards and 7.9 assists, shooting 51.9% from the field and 47.6% from beyond the arc, with 1.0 made treys per game.
 Kevin Durant is averaging 20.9 points, 3.6 assists and 6.1 boards.
 Jabari Smith Jr. is averaging 16.8 points, 6.6 rebounds and 2.2 assists. Defensively, he averages 0.9 steals and 1.1 blocked shots.
 Amen Thompson's numbers on the season are 15.3 points, 6.8 rebounds and 3.1 assists per contest, shooting 51.4% from the floor.
 Fred VanVleet averages 13.7 points, 3.1 boards and 5.6 assists, shooting 43.0% from the floor and 38.7% from beyond the arc, with 2.9 made 3-pointers per game.
 Jazz Leaders
 Keyonte George is averaging 20.4 points, 4.5 boards and 6.5 assists for the Jazz.
 Per game, Darryn Peterson gives the Jazz 16.3 points, 4.0 boards and 4.0 assists. He also averages 1.2 steals and 0.8 blocks.
 The Jazz get 13.3 points per game from Ace Bailey, plus 6.7 rebounds and 1.9 assists.
 Per game, Jaxson Hayes provides the Jazz 8.5 points, 6.1 boards and 1.6 assists, plus 1.0 steal and 1.5 blocks (eighth in league).
 Isaiah Collier's numbers on the season are 7.2 points, 3.5 boards and 4.1 assists per contest. He is sinking 45.3% of his shots from the floor.
